newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Unilabs acquires rest of Pathologie Labor.
newsitem.headline: Unilabs acquires rest of Pathologie Labor.

text.p: Unilabs SA said it had acqurired the remaining 49.8 percent stake in Pathologie Labor Brunnhof AG it did not already own for 3.45 million Swiss francs.
Unilabs, a clinical laboratory, had run the company since it was founded in 1988, it said in a statement.
Profits for the fiscal year ending on May 31, 1997 go in their entirety to Unilabs, it said.
"This purchase should contribute to a significant increase in the estimated consolidated results of the Unlibas group in the current business year that ends on May 31, 1997," it said.
